coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 Camellia 这一种 128 位 Feistel 分组密码：128/192/256 位密钥、18/24 轮、FL/FL^-1 层、F/S/P 组件、四个 S-box、KL/KR/KA/KB 与 Sigma 密钥调度、官方附录 B 的三组向量、CMS/OpenPGP/TLS 使用及其现行限制；不把 AES、SEED、MISTY1、CAST-128、CMS/OpenPGP/TLS 协议或工作模式并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the Camellia 128-bit Feistel block cipher: 128/192/256-bit keys, 18/24 rounds, FL/FL^-1 layers, F/S/P components, four S-boxes, the KL/KR/KA/KB and Sigma key schedule, the three Appendix B vectors, CMS/OpenPGP/TLS use and current limitations. It does not absorb AES, SEED, MISTY1, CAST-128, the CMS/OpenPGP/TLS protocols, modes of operation or the whole library.
